prompt: An adult and an eleven-year-old arrive at ten twenty during rain. They booked a clipboard but have also brought their own. What can they do together?
promptZh: 一名成人帶著十一歲孩子在下雨時於十點二十分抵達。他們原本預約了寫字板，也自行帶了一個。他們可以一起做什麼？

options.text: Sort indoors and count on receiving the booked clipboard.
options.zh: 在室內分類，並一定能領到原先預約的寫字板。
options.whyZh: 室內照常，但預約只保留至十點十五分，不能保證仍可領取。

options.text: Sort indoors using the clipboard they brought.
options.zh: 用自備的寫字板在室內分類。
options.whyZh: 室內活動不受下雨影響，孩子可由成人陪同；逾時也可用自備寫字板加入。

options.text: Wait for the rain to stop, then load boxes together in the yard.
options.zh: 等雨停，再一起到院子裝載箱子。
options.whyZh: 孩子未滿十二歲，不可參與院子裝載，即使雨停也不能一起裝。

options.text: Collect toys outdoors while waiting for the indoor sorting to resume.
options.zh: 在戶外收玩具，等室內分類重新開始。
options.whyZh: 下雨時停止的是院子裝載，室內分類沒有中斷。

evidence: Younger volunteers can sort toys indoors with an adult. | If it rains, we'll stop loading in the yard, but the indoor sorting will continue. | If you booked a clipboard, pick it up at the welcome desk by ten fifteen. | If you arrive late, you can still join the sorting with a clipboard you bring.
explanationZh: 室內活動不受下雨影響，孩子可由成人陪同；逾時也可用自備寫字板加入。
difficultyRationale: Combine supervision/age, unaffected indoor venue, cutoff and own-clipboard exception.

vocabulary.note: 此處指在室內按類別分揀玩具，不是到院子搬運箱子。
